galaxy_distances.policy: Adopt published galaxy distances as fixed fictional facts
galaxy_distances.cross_catalog_policy: Record which published value each analysis uses; preserve provenance and do not silently alter the baseline

mandatory: Photon-supplied gravitating deposits or explicitly derived field response
excluded_active_premises: Big Bang initial history or derived standard rulers/chronology
Independent assumed dark-matter component or fitted halo supplied as a source
observations_policy: Retain observations; separate and remove interpretations/reductions that require excluded premises, except explicitly accepted published galaxy distance values
historical_policy: Preserve prior files and results for provenance; excluded theories are not active candidates
deposits_policy: Derive source energy, production, capture, support and gravity; do not rename an assumed dark-matter halo as a deposit
still_unresolved: Microscopic photon/companion conversion and timing law
Source and fuel history without excluded cosmological assumptions
Capture, storage and joint motion/lensing response
Candidate-specific observational likelihood and fresh validation data
